plan.summary:
Retry backoff now adds random jitter so clients that failed together do not retry at the same time.

- `backoff(n)` adds `jitter(exponential / 2)` to the exponential delay.
- The result is still capped at `MAX_MS`, so jitter cannot push a delay past the maximum.
plan.riskRationale: One-line change to a delay calculation. The cap at MAX_MS still applies. The change makes retry timing non-deterministic, and no tests are in the diff.
plan.storyArc: One change: backoff delay gains random jitter before the cap. This spreads out retries from clients that failed together.

topics.title: Jitter added to retry backoff
topics.narrativeBrief: How does `backoff` now compute the delay, and why does jitter help? Verify what `jitter` returns (range and units) and that the `MAX_MS` cap still bounds the result.
